using namespace std;

class FastReader {
public:
    istream& in;
    string buffer;
    size_t pos;

    FastReader(istream& input_stream) : in(input_stream), pos(0) {}

    string next() {
        string token;
        while (true) {
            if (pos >= buffer.size()) {
                if (!(getline(in, buffer))) return "";
                buffer += '\n'; // ensure there is always at least one character
                pos = 0;
            }
            while (pos < buffer.size() && isspace(buffer[pos])) ++pos;
            size_t start = pos;
            while (pos < buffer.size() && !isspace(buffer[pos])) ++pos;
            if (start != pos) {
                token = buffer.substr(start, pos - start);
                return token;
            }
        }
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return atoll(next().c_str());
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

class FastWriter {
public:
    ostringstream oss;
    void println(long long val) {
        oss << val << "\n";
    }
    template<typename T>
    void println(const vector<T>& a) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            oss << a[i] << (i + 1 < a.size() ? ' ' : '\n');
        }
    }
    void flush() {
        cout << oss.str();
        oss.str("");
        oss.clear();
    }
};

class MathUtils {
public:
    static const double EPS;
    static int compare(double x, double y) {
        if (x + EPS < y) return -1;
        if (x - EPS > y) return 1;
        return 0;
    }

    static int binarySearch(int left, int right, function<bool(int)> leftShouldAdvance) {
        while (left < right) {
            int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
            if (leftShouldAdvance(mid)) {
                left = mid + 1;
            } else {
                right = mid;
            }
        }
        return left;
    }

    static int lowerBound(const vector<int>& a, int x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid){ return a[mid] < x; });
    }

    static int lowerBound(const vector<long long>& a, long long x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid){ return a[mid] < x; });
    }

    static int upperBound(const vector<int>& a, int x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid){ return a[mid] <= x; });
    }

    static int upperBound(const vector<long long>& a, long long x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid){ return a[mid] <= x; });
    }

    static int ternarySearchMaxInt(int left, int right, function<int(int)> f) {
        return binarySearch(left, right, [&](int mid){ return f(mid) < f(min(mid + 1, right - 1)); });
    }

    static int ternarySearchMaxLong(int left, int right, function<long long(int)> f) {
        return binarySearch(left, right, [&](int mid){ return f(mid) < f(min(mid + 1, right - 1)); });
    }

    static long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
        while (b > 0) {
            long long t = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = t;
        }
        return a;
    }

    static long long extendedEuclidean(long long a, long long b, long long* xy) {
        if (b == 0) {
            xy[0] = 1;
            xy[1] = 0;
            return a;
        }
        long long r = extendedEuclidean(b, a % b, xy);
        long long t = xy[0];
        xy[0] = xy[1];
        xy[1] = t - a / b * xy[1];
        return r;
    }

    static long long lcm(long long a, long long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }
};
const double MathUtils::EPS = 1e-12;

class Modulo {
public:
    long long mod;
    Modulo(long long m) : mod(m) {}

    long long plus(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = a + b;
        if (c >= mod) c -= mod;
        return c;
    }

    long long minus(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = a - b;
        if (c < 0) c += mod;
        return c;
    }

    long long times(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a % mod) * (b % mod) % mod;
    }

    long long div(long long a, long long b) {
        return times(a, pow(b, mod - 2));
    }

    long long pow(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = 1;
        long long base = a % mod;
        long long exp = b;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) c = (c * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return c;
    }

    long long factorial(int n) {
        long long f = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f = (f * i) % mod;
        }
        return f;
    }

    vector<long long> factorials(int n) {
        vector<long long> f(n + 1, 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f[i] = (f[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }
        return f;
    }

    long long combination(int n, int k, const vector<long long>& factorials_cache) {
        return div(factorials_cache[n], times(factorials_cache[k], factorials_cache[n - k]));
    }

    long long combination(int n, int k) {
        return div(factorial(n), times(factorial(k), factorial(n - k)));
    }
};

int main() {
    FastReader in(cin);
    FastWriter out;

    int t = 1; // Only one test case as per original code
    while (t-- > 0) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        long long kt = in.nextLong();

        if (kt >= n) {
            out.println(0);
            continue;
        }

        int k = (int)kt;
        const long long MOD = 998244353;
        Modulo mod(MOD);
        vector<long long> facts = mod.factorials(n);
        long long ans = 0;
        int c = n - k;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            long long tVal = mod.times(mod.combination(c, i, facts), mod.pow(c - i, n));
            if (i % 2 == 0) {
                ans = mod.plus(ans, tVal);
            } else {
                ans = mod.minus(ans, tVal);
            }
        }
        ans = mod.times(ans, mod.combination(n, n - k, facts));
        if (k > 0) ans = mod.times(ans, 2);
        out.println(ans);
    }
    out.flush();
    return 0;
}
